positioning: ONEX RF are masters of RF heating. Everything else — the tippers, the welders, the automation, the dies — follows from that one competence.
summary: A vertically integrated manufacturer of RF welding and catheter forming systems for the medical device industry. ONEX designs and builds its own generators, controls and mechanics, which is what makes it possible to change a process quickly rather than negotiate with someone else's supply chain.

timeline.title: ONEX Automation founded
timeline.body: Started as a consulting firm of four to five engineers providing mechanical and controls design.

timeline.title: ONEX Enterprises Corp. established
timeline.body: By 2004 the team had grown to between 15 and 30 people, and the business moved to a larger facility.

timeline.title: First RF welder project
timeline.body: The beginning of the shift from general automation consulting to RF as a specialism.

timeline.title: First RF tipping project
timeline.body: The same RF competence applied to catheter forming — induction rather than dielectric heating.

timeline.title: ONEX RF Corp. established
timeline.body: Formalised as a vertically integrated manufacturer of RF welding and catheter forming systems.

differentiators.title: Vertically integrated
differentiators.body: Electronics and mechanical components are designed and manufactured in house, down to the RF generators. When a process needs to change, the people who can change it are in the building.

differentiators.title: Engineers across the table
differentiators.body: The team functions as an extension of a customer's R&D group rather than as a vendor — the same people from first conversation through validation and into service.

differentiators.title: One competence, two technologies
differentiators.body: RF induction heating for forming, dielectric RF heating for welding. Both are the same underlying mastery applied to different problems.
